description: One-handed scissor-action pruning shears for stems and small branches, manual or powered; bypass, anvil and ratchet are the cutting actions.
Hand-held saw with a powered toothed chain running round a guide bar, for felling, pruning and cutting wood; petrol, cordless or corded.
Powered saw head on a long pole for cutting high branches from the ground.
Powered handle and motor unit that takes interchangeable cutting attachments such as a grass trimmer, hedge trimmer, pole pruner or brush cutter.
Self-guided battery mower that mows a set area on its own.
Lawn or garden tractor with a mowing deck but no rear power take-off and no large three-point hitch; one with both is in Farm & Forestry Equipment.
Stone, gravel included, and bark sold as decorative ground cover.
Powered machine that blows leaves and debris into heaps; a blower-vac that also sucks and shreds is the same machine with a vacuum function.
Chipper for branches and brush that is not tractor-driven, towed or self-propelled, for tree surgery and grounds work.
Wheeled container with handles for carrying soil, waste and materials in a garden; a garden cart is the same thing.
Device that sprays water over an area of lawn or bed; pop-up, oscillating and rotary heads are all sold.
Set of pipe, drippers and fittings that delivers water drop by drop to plants; balcony and terrace sets come in different sizes.
Pump made to move water for watering and irrigation in a garden.
Pump made to circulate water in a garden pond, fountain or water feature.
Container that collects and stores rainwater for garden use.
Flexible waterproof sheet laid to form a garden pond.
Rigid moulded pond shell set into the ground.
Decorative outer container without drainage that holds a potted plant.
Netting made to support climbing plants or protect crops from birds and pests.
Open lattice panel on which climbing plants are trained.
Arched frame over a path on which climbing plants are grown.
Free-standing tapering frame on which climbing plants are grown.
Material spread on the soil surface to hold moisture and suppress weeds; bark mulch included.
Material dug into soil to improve its structure or fertility.
Weed killer made to kill or control unwanted plants.
Product that kills or repels insects and other pests on plants.
Lamp made to give light for plant growth; LED, HPS, CMH and fluorescent are the lamp technologies.
Swimming pool with flexible walls, held up by an inflatable ring or by the water.
Heat pump that warms pool water with heat drawn from the air.
Kit for testing pool water for chlorine, pH and other values.
Chemical that disinfects pool water, chlorine tablets and granules included.
Replacement cutting blade made for a mower.
Replacement cutting line made for a string trimmer or brush cutter head.
Replacement pleated element made for a pool cartridge filter.
Replacement blade made to fit a scythe snath.
Shaft with grips made to carry a scythe blade, sold alone.
Replacement grid or grid set made for a pool DE filter.
